A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same READ study and contain the complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text and visual inspection support comparison of all eight tables, eight figures, equations, and Algorithm 1.

before.justification: v4 reports original READ segmentation and false-premise evaluation results, component ablations, and qualitative analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v7 retains original READ benchmark results in Tables 2–5, ablations in Tables 6–8, and qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same LLaVA encoder, Similarity as Points module, discrete-to-continuous interpolation, SAM decoder, and training losses.

E1.justification: The training datasets and task coverage are unchanged. Both evaluate reasoning segmentation on ReasonSeg, referring segmentation on RefCOCO(+/g), and false-premise handling on FP-RefCOCO(+/g).

E2.justification: Tables 1–5 retain identical comparator membership. For example, Table 5 includes LISA-7B, Cascading, and SESAME in both versions, while Table 3 compares READ-13B with LISA-13B. Citation renumbering does not change these comparisons.

E3.justification: Both retain the same splits, short/long-query evaluations, 7B/13B configurations, 239-sample fine-tuning designation, metrics, and training budgets. Appendix A retains the same threshold-search procedure and training ratios.

E4.justification: The similarity-map and point-prompt analyses, SasP and backbone ablations, appendix point-threshold/count sweep, and qualitative failure cases are unchanged. No analysis or tested question is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting practice is retained.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1–8 and the qualitative examples match. READ-7B ReasonSeg validation cIoU remains 67.6 in Table 2, and FP-RefCOCO+ segmentation remains 54.54 in Table 5. Appendix ablation values also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–15 retain the same definitions, interpolation reasoning, objectives, and appendix threshold maximization. Differences in mathematical text are spacing and typesetting changes.

C1.justification: Both retain the same claims about the semantic role of the <SEG> token, the plug-and-play SasP design, and READ's reasoning, referring-segmentation, and false-premise capabilities. Small wording edits do not alter contribution scope.

C2.justification: The semantic-alignment and failure explanations in Section 3.2 and Appendix B, backbone tradeoff in Section 5.6, and applicability and token-necessity discussion in Appendix E are retained without substantive revision.

D1.justification: Sections 5.1 and A.2 retain the same hardware, training duration, optimizer settings, initialization, data ratios, and LoRA ranks. Code/model access statements and the repository address are unchanged.

R1.justification: v4's mPLUG-Owl reference [48] is replaced by the distinct mPLUG-Owl2 work [47] in v7, although Section 2.1 retains the older mPLUG-OWL description. This is a limited cited-work substitution; the broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v7 makes localized grammar and phrasing edits, updates affiliations and contact information, consolidates duplicate LoRA references, and revises bibliographic formatting and metadata. Main-section and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: There are small caption edits, including Figure 1 and Tables 2–3, and limited text and bibliography reflow. All figure panels and table structures are retained without additions, removals, or substantial rearrangement.

improvement.justification: Consolidating duplicate LoRA entries, repairing malformed author listings, and polishing awkward phrasing modestly improve reference usability and readability. Scientific evidence remains unchanged. The editorial benefit is partly offset by replacing mPLUG-Owl with mPLUG-Owl2 without updating Section 2.1's older-model description.
